about: The route eval of the ask box (AT-17), from decision 09 of .scratch/front-door/. A question with source 'real' is one the commissioner asked. A question with source 'claude' is written by Claude. Expect is topic:<key>, team:<name>, free_answer, miss, refuse, or judgment. A judgment question has no fixed route and is not in the count. The questions ran on week 8 of the 2026 season. A question with turns asks after those earlier turns of its Thread, oldest first (H18).
